info.name: ABDM Connector - Complete Sequenced Flow (M1 to M4)
info.description: Complete, sequence-wise ABDM V3 collection ready for Thunder Client (VS Code) & Postman. Every request has exact direct URL (http://localhost:4000), headers, and working sample body.

item.name: 0. Setup & Health Check
0.1 GET Server Health & DB Status

request.description: Verify that the local ABDM connector server is running and Postgres DB is connected.

item.name: 0.2 POST Register Hospital in Connector

request.description: Register a hospital with HFR ID in the local database.

item.name: 0.3 POST Generate Hospital Client ID & Secret

request.description: Generates clientId and secret for the hospital HMIS to call connector APIs.

item.name: 1. Milestone 1 - ABHA Enrollment (Patient Onboarding)
1.1a POST Request OTP via Mobile Number

request.description: Triggers ABDM Enrollment OTP directly to patient mobile: 9408111252.

item.name: 1.1b POST Request OTP via Aadhaar Number

request.description: Triggers ABDM Enrollment OTP to registered Aadhaar (Sandbox: 999999990019).

item.name: 1.2 POST Step 2: Verify OTP & Create ABHA Number

request.description: Submit the 6-digit OTP received by the patient to activate their 14-digit ABHA Number.

item.name: 1.3 GET Step 3: Get ABHA Address Suggestions

request.description: Fetches auto-generated ABHA address suggestions based on patient name/year.

item.name: 1.4 POST Step 4: Create Custom ABHA Address (PHR)

request.description: Assigns the selected ABHA handle (e.g. mansurijiyan2004@sbx) to the patient profile.

item.name: 1.5 GET Step 5: View Patient ABHA Profile

request.description: Retrieves complete demographic details returned by ABDM.

item.name: 1.6 GET Step 6: Download ABHA Card (PDF/PNG)

request.description: Downloads the official ABHA Card with photo & QR code.

item.name: 1.7 POST Scan Patient ABHA Card QR (Card Scanner & Auto-Registration)

request.description: Scans and decodes patient's physical/digital ABHA card QR code from receptionist scanner gun or camera. Extracts demographics and auto-registers the patient for instant OPD check-in.

item.name: 1.8a POST Step 1: Request OTP for DL Enrollment

request.description: Requests OTP via ABDM to registered mobile number for Driving Licence based ABHA creation.

item.name: 1.8b POST Step 2: Verify OTP for DL Enrollment

request.description: Submits 6-digit OTP received by patient to authorize DL enrollment.

item.name: 1.8c POST Step 3: Enrol by Document (Driving Licence)

request.description: Submits Driving Licence details and demographics to create a provisional 14-digit ABHA number.

item.name: 1.8d POST Step 4: Simulate Complete DL Flow (One-Click Test)

request.description: One-click complete test simulation of Driving Licence ABHA enrollment (Step 1 OTP -> Step 2 Verify -> Step 3 Document creation with photos -> EHR registration).

item.name: 2. Milestone 2 - HIP Care Context Linking (Hospital Records)
2.1 POST Step 1: Generate Link Token

request.description: Requests temporary link token from ABDM to link records to patient's ABHA.

item.name: 2.2 POST Step 2: Link Care Contexts to Patient ABHA

request.description: Pushes hospital visit/test references to patient's central ABHA record.

item.name: 2.3 POST Step 3: Send SMS Deep Link Notification

request.description: Sends an SMS to the patient with a deep link to view linked hospital records.

item.name: 2.4 GET View All Linked Records in HMIS

request.description: Hospital receptionist views all patient care contexts linked so far.

item.name: 2.5 GET View Hospital Legal Consent Register

request.description: View all granted, revoked, and expired patient consents recorded at this hospital.

item.name: 2.6 POST Test Simulator: Simulate Patient Consent Grant/Revoke

request.description: Simulates patient granting or revoking consent without opening real phone.

item.name: 3. Milestone 3 - HIU Doctor Portal (Doctor View FHIR)
3.1 POST Step 1: Clinician Login

request.description: Doctor logs into their hospital EHR/EMR clinician portal.

item.name: 3.2 GET Step 2: Search / Select Patient

request.description: Doctor looks up patient Mansuri Jiyan before requesting medical records.

item.name: 3.3 POST Step 3: Create Consent Request

request.description: Doctor requests patient's permission to view their past medical records.

item.name: 3.4 GET Step 4: Check Consent Request Status

request.description: Checks if the patient has approved (GRANTED), DENIED, or if it is pending.

item.name: 3.5 POST Step 5: Test Simulator: Patient Approves Consent

request.description: Simulates patient tapping 'GRANT' on their phone to approve the doctor's request.

item.name: 3.6 GET Step 6: Decrypt & View FHIR Health Data

request.description: Doctor views decrypted FHIR bundle (Prescriptions, Lab Results, Doctor Notes).

item.name: 4. Milestone 4 - HFR & HPR Registries (Sequential Flow)
4.1 GET Medical Courses Master (MBBS, MD)

request.description: Step 1: Returns recognized medical courses master list (MBBS, MD, MS, BDS, etc.).

item.name: 4.2 GET Medical Councils Master (NMC, etc.)

request.description: Step 2: Returns master list of State Medical Councils (NMC, Gujarat Medical Council, etc.).

item.name: 4.3 GET Search Doctor by HPR ID

request.description: Step 3: Looks up doctor verification status and degree by national HPR ID.

item.name: 4.4 GET Search Doctor by Mobile Number

request.description: Step 4: Checks whether doctor is registered in HPR by mobile number.

item.name: 4.5 POST Send Doctor Login OTP

request.description: Step 5: Triggers OTP to doctor mobile for authenticated login.

item.name: 4.6 POST Verify Doctor Login OTP

request.description: Step 6: Verifies doctor login OTP and returns doctor auth session token (X-Token).

item.name: 4.7 GET Doctor Full Profile

request.description: Step 7: Retrieves complete doctor profile, degrees, and council registration validity.

item.name: 4.8 GET Doctor Official ID Card

request.description: Step 8: Retrieves official digital HPR ID card image for healthcare professional.

item.name: 4.9 POST Search Hospital in HFR Registry

request.description: Step 9: Checks if hospital is already registered in Govt HFR before creating a new one.

item.name: 4.10 POST Onboard Facility Step 1: Basic Info

request.description: Step 10 (Onboarding 1/4): Submits hospital name, location, and generates trackingId.

item.name: 4.11 POST Onboard Facility Step 2: Additional Info

request.description: Step 11 (Onboarding 2/4): Records hospital ownership and system of medicine.

item.name: 4.12 POST Onboard Facility Step 3: Detailed Info

request.description: Step 12 (Onboarding 3/4): Records bed capacity, ICU, and clinical departments.

item.name: 4.13 POST Onboard Facility Step 4: Final Submit

request.description: Step 13 (Onboarding 4/4): Final submission to Govt State Registrar; returns approved facilityId (IN...).

item.name: 4.14 POST Send Facility Owner Contact OTP

request.description: Step 14: Sends authorization OTP to facility nodal officer before linking doctors.

item.name: 4.15 POST Verify Facility Contact OTP

request.description: Step 15: Verifies hospital nodal officer OTP and confirms facility authorization.

item.name: 4.16 POST Assign Doctors & Staff to Facility

request.description: Step 16: Links verified Doctor (HPR ID) to Hospital (Facility ID). Completes Milestone 4!

item.name: 5. Scan & Share (Fast OPD Check-in)
5.1 POST Scan Hospital QR & Generate Token

request.description: Patient scans the QR code at hospital OPD reception.

item.name: 5.2 POST Share ABHA Profile to Hospital Queue

request.description: ABHA profile arrives automatically into the hospital receptionist's queue.

item.name: 5.3 GET View OPD Reception Queue

request.description: Hospital receptionist sees all patients waiting in line with pre-filled ABHA forms.
